blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: operating system — System software managing hardware resources and services.
process — An executing instance of a program.
device driver — Software allowing the OS to communicate with hardware.
spooling — Queuing data such as print jobs for a slower peripheral.

blocks.title: Manage processes
blocks.text: The OS creates and schedules processes; programs share CPU time.

blocks.title: Manage resources
blocks.text: Memory, files and device access are mediated by the OS.

blocks.title: Provide services
blocks.text: Interfaces, user accounts and access controls make a computer usable.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model answer
blocks.text: The OS allocates CPU time to both processes; the file system writes the document to storage; a device driver controls sound output. Memory management keeps process data protected. Check: link each claim to the scenario and use precise OCR terminology.
